suggestions.name: NNsight + NDIF
suggestions.description: Blog post announcing remote white-box access to interpretable looped transformer models (Inkling 2 Mini) via NNsight and the National Deep Inference Fabric, including a community interpretability challenge for developing new lenses for looped architectures.

suggestions.name: NDIF — Looped Lens Challenge
suggestions.description: Open interpretability competition: build a lens that reveals what Thinking Machines' looped open-weights model Inkling 2 Mini computes but doesn't write out. Run remotely on the National Deep Inference Fabric (NDIF) with a free API key; results go on a public leaderboard.

suggestions.name: Verification Arena
suggestions.description: An open-source testbed for compute verification approaches designed to distinguish between inference and training on GPUs, with blue team/red team competitions to develop and stress-test verification schemes. Directly addresses AI safety concerns around compute governance and model training verification.

suggestions.name: Staffing the New Congress — Guide for AI Safety Applicants
suggestions.description: Living guide for AI safety people applying to join the staffs of newly elected U.S. Congress members and governors, who are hiring over the next 2–3 months. Covers eligibility (most paid roles need U.S. citizenship), which jobs and offices to target, and where to send a resume.

suggestions.name: FAR.AI
suggestions.description: FAR.AI is a research and education nonprofit focused on ensuring advanced AI is trustworthy, secure and beneficial. It hosts events, runs research programs, and provides grantmaking and collaborative workspace (FAR.Labs) for researchers developing solutions to AI risks.

suggestions.name: Frontier AI Safety Act (FASIA)
suggestions.description: California state legislation requiring major frontier AI developers to publish and meet minimum standards for allocating R&D computing resources to AI safety research, with independent verification and reporting requirements.

suggestions.name: Mycelium — Research Scientist / Engineer
suggestions.description: Full-time ML research on robust moral values in AI systems, with a focus on animal welfare and neglected moral patients: building benchmarks, evals and empirical research. Bay Area preferred, remote considered. $130K–$225K (senior $225K–$320K).

suggestions.name: CNAS Technology and National Security Program - Fellow / Senior Fellow
suggestions.description: CNAS is hiring a Fellow/Senior Fellow to lead research on AI compute governance, including monitoring, allocation, and control of computing power for national security. The role involves developing policy recommendations on AI hardware, chip supply chains, export controls, and data center infrastructure.

suggestions.name: CNAS AI Policy Lab - AI Policy Associate / AI Policy Researcher
suggestions.description: CNAS is hiring an AI Policy Associate/Researcher to conduct technically rigorous policy research on risks from advanced AI systems, including alignment challenges, cybersecurity, biosecurity, and loss of control risks, to inform U.S. national security policymakers.

suggestions.name: CNAS AI Policy Lab - Fellow/Senior Fellow, Competition Policy and AI
suggestions.description: CNAS is hiring a Fellow or Senior Fellow to lead research on competition policy and AI, examining whether current competition frameworks are fit for purpose in the era of advancing AI capabilities. The role involves developing policy recommendations on economic and national security impacts of competition policy on safe and secure AI development.

suggestions.name: AI Security Institute (AISI)
suggestions.description: The AI Security Institute is hiring a Head of Private Office and Private Secretaries to work directly with senior leadership at the world's largest government AI safety team, supporting organizational operations and strategy.

suggestions.name: Agentic AI Safety Research Harness User Study
suggestions.description: A user research study testing a new research harness tool designed for agentic AI safety research. Participants join a 2-hour remote session to use the harness on ongoing research projects and provide feedback via survey.

suggestions.name: Meridian Labs — Member of Technical Staff, Research
suggestions.description: Meridian Labs builds open-source evaluation tools (Inspect AI, Inspect Scout, Petri) used by AI Security Institutes in five countries and by METR, Apollo and Redwood. Research role on automated alignment audits, agent monitoring and transcript analysis.

suggestions.name: Strep A Vaccine Fund
suggestions.description: A $200 million fund supporting vaccine development against Strep A, one of the world's most neglected infectious diseases. Provides grants for research across the vaccine development pipeline, from basic science to clinical trials and deployment preparation.
